construction.implementation_origin: New implementation written in this isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict object: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, timezone-aware as_of, nonempty products, preferences.weights, customer, events; optional positive half_life_days defaults to 30.
shared_schema.products: Unique nonempty id and name, attributes comprising price_usd (alias price), weight_g (alias weight_kg), battery_hours (alias battery_minutes). Finite nonnegative numeric values only. Alias collisions and unknown fields rejected. Prices are synthetic USD only.
shared_schema.preferences: Exactly three nonnegative weights: price_usd, weight_g, battery_hours. At least one positive; normalized to sum to one.
shared_schema.customer: Nonempty name; goal explore/buy/learn; experience beginner/experienced; unique completed_steps from profile/learn/compare/select/checkout.
shared_schema.events: List of product_id, kind browse/purchase, and timezone-aware ISO at <= as_of. Unknown product references rejected. Repeated events count as repeated interactions.
shared_schema.output: One accumulated envelope retaining validated normalized input plus comparison, onboarding, behavior. Rankings contain each product once, rank, score; ties resolve by product ID.
shared_schema.validation: Shared helpers and boundary validator used before and after each stage. Duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers, malformed JSON and file/validation errors return status error and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Validated normalized catalog, side-by-side rows and preference ranking determine preferred_product_id, preserved comparison_order, and personalized next step.
Validated preferred_product_id supplies seed boost; exact next_step propagates into discovery output alongside prior comparison preference scores and event history.

behavior.comparison: Catalog min-max utilities: lower price/weight and higher battery are better. Constant attributes receive utility 1. Score is weighted sum.
behavior.onboarding: General goal/experience/completed-step rules select one next action. Running comparison satisfies compare automatically. All customers confirm profile; beginners or learn-goal customers receive guidance; selection follows; only buy goal adds checkout. Completed sequences return done. No purchase or profile mutation occurs.
behavior.personalization: Activity sums browse=1 and purchase=3 multiplied by 2^(-age_days/half_life_days), normalized by maximum activity. Score=0.6 preference+0.3 activity+0.1 onboarding seed. Empty or fully underflowed history uses cold-start score=0.9 preference+0.1 seed.
behavior.determinism: Explicit as_of, no clock/random/network access, event accumulation sorted, ID tie-breaks, input not mutated.
behavior.fixtures: All example products, customer and events are explicitly synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli: Verified exit 0, one JSON object, status ok; error-path tests verify exit 2 and JSON status error.
test_outcomes.deliverable_check: Verified directory contains exactly the four required files.
